background: Barclays Bank PLC is the non-ring-fenced bank of Barclays, housing the corporate and investment bank, the international cards business and the private bank, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ on average across all three main agencies and none is lower, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against UK majors, with CET1 of 12.6% in the bottom quarter but leverage of 5.5% in the top quarter; liquidity is the weaker side, LCR of 140% below the median and NSFR of 112% in the bottom quarter. LCR has fallen 14 points since 30 Jun 2025 while the other ratios are broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 25 Sep 2026, is a senior trading departure, alongside older items on repeated risk-platform outages and a strong first-half result.
